# Retain controller startup authority before child construction

The source review in ASTRA-REAL-ENGINE-CONNECTION01-FAILURE-2026-09-14.md rejects connection01. Begin a smaller repair in a fresh _scratch/real-startup-authority-repair01 directory. Preserve both rejected proposals and every accepted test. This is source authoring only; no candidate execution or new approval is granted.

Read the qualified originals: _scratch/windows-interrupted-owner-native-proposal02/asr_loading_adapter.py and trusted_asr_resolver.py, the exact lifecycle/factory methods they call, and _scratch/protected-engine-ownership-repair02/owned_generation_protocol.py. Read the source plan and independent failure verdicts. Derive qualified originals, not the rejected connection01 files.

Implement only the controller-owned startup record and issuance/validation needed to retain the exact accepted release authority, TrustedManifest selection, Admission, RuntimeProfile and live lifecycle permit before a worker is started. A reconstructed dataclass or a caller-supplied object with matching fields must not grant authority. Keep the local permit local. Validate the current configured real approval/release/profile before any filesystem service, native start, import or constructor. Recheck the live session/record and the immutable selected model/manifest/profile bindings at consumption. Preserve exception-aware custody when startup fails.

Inspect the existing _OwnedASRStart and generated adapter route before choosing a separate private record or registry. Preserve their generated behavior and original tests. Missing complete real manifest, profile, runtime state and fixed bootstrap remain refusals. Do not populate REAL_APPROVAL, RELEASE_AUTHORITY or RUNTIME_PROFILE. A synthetic test anchor may exist only in the separately loaded inert fixture, never as an alternate production authority.

This unit stops at the controller-to-fixed-worker seam. State precisely what authenticated child transport and child-local issuance remain unimplemented. Do not invent an IPC trust witness, close the real gate with shaped objects, or claim a complete engine connection. No edits to B3, WhisperX, namespaces, native transport or constructor callbacks belong in this unit.

Add focused proposed cases for absent approval, copied/reconstructed selection or startup, changed release/profile, revoked or foreign permit, selected-model mismatch, same-value foreign records and first-error preservation. Use the existing inert adapter/lifecycle fixture and loader. Read every called signature; preserve all accepted assertions. List exact new ordered case IDs without predicting passes. Do not run or import tests. Document any prospective existing fixture conflict with its exact proposed diff and leave it unapplied.

Deliver complete before copies and mechanical unified diffs, a source map that binds actual derivative bytes and all original inputs, tests, and a short report distinguishing implemented checks from the remaining child seam. Root will independently review and admit any later fake qualification. Do not add an observer framework.

No Python startup, native calls, model/support/checkpoint/D2-output access, physical journal read, fetch, paid API, production edits, shared handoff changes, commits, push, merge or subagents. Never access the live index or port 5179. This source repair does not reopen D1/D2 or authorize D3/D4, PCM/filter/inference, diarization, packaging, installation, website or marketing.
